t: You're standing at Whiteleys, on Queensway in Bayswater. This was a shopping centre, built in the space of the old William Whiteley department store, which opened in 1911 as one of London's first department stores. It stood alongside Selfridge's, Liberty's and Harrods. The store was founded by William Whiteley, an English entrepreneur of the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, who died in 1907. His company, William Whiteley Limited, gave the place its name, and the building is now Grade Two listed.
